description: This source file implements functions related to processing and serializing HTTP MBO (Memory Buffer Object) files, specifically focusing on the function HttpMboFileOutput which handles reading a file and serializing its content for HTTP message output.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboFileOutput(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSerializeContext)
methods.description: Serializes the current HTTP message by reading the associated file content and passing it through a serialization interface, handling chunked reading if the file is larger than the defined write unit.
